text:
sara_p: Quick heads-up — planning a compact route-swap for NA->NA2 nodes to absorb a small surge this afternoon. Target window 18:15-18:45 UTC. Who's on deploy? Smoke policy: quick DNS tilt to 5% then ramp to 25 if green. Ping when you can.

amit_k: I can own the deploy. Can we keep the initial step short (10m) and run the verification probes listed below? :+1:

jen_w: I can run rollback readiness and monitor dashboards. Will stand by for canary results. Any extra traffic-shaping rules?

luis_r: FYI we need to lower the DNS TTL to 30s 10m before the tilt. I'll do the TTL change if someone drops a quick playbook snippet, or I can just run the command:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZ --change-batch file://dns-ttl-30.json
```

hana_ops: Smoke checklist (short):
1) TTL -> 30s (luis)
2) Bring up canary route at 5%
3) Run perf probe: `curl -sS https://na2.example/probe | jq .latency`
4) KV/cache warm-up: `python tools/warm_cache.py --model gpt-small --nodes 2`
5) Monitor error budget + 95p latency for 15m
If any step spikes error rate or 95p > 350ms, roll back.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline scheduled by amit_k at 2025-03-17T18:10:00Z. Job: `route-swap-mini-surge-v1`. ETA ~5m after start.

marco_t: I'll handle post-swap validation (trace sampling + end-to-end tests). Can you post exact probe ids and dashboard links? I'll be on call during the window.

sara_p: Thanks. Probe IDs: perf-probe-na2, smoke-endpoint-na2, healthcheck-e2e. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/d/na2/latency and https://console.redwood/d/na2/errors

amit_k: Starting TTL change at 18:05 UTC. I'll announce each step here. Rollback plan: revert DNS TTL and swap weights back to baseline, run cache flush if needed. Thumbs on standby?

jen_w: Thumbs. I'll predefine the rollback commands and paste here before 18:15.

luis_r: TTL change complete at 18:06 UTC. Verified via `dig +nocmd +noall +answer example.com` -> TTL 30.

hana_ops: Canary at 5% up. Running perf probes now. Patch notes: no model change, only routing weight.

marco_t: First 5m looks clean — 95p latency steady, errors flat. Proceed to 25% in 5m.

amit_k: Ramp to 25% now. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: route-swap-mini-surge-v1 reached 25% at 18:26 UTC.

sara_p: All green from product side. Keep an eye for any anomaly. If anything weird, throw rollback.

jen_w: Rollback commands (if needed):
```
# revert weights
scripts/route_weight_reset.sh --env na --file baseline-weights.json
# revert TTL
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZ --change-batch file://dns-ttl-300.json
```

luis_r: Noted. I'll hold the previous TTL record exported.

hana_ops: Final check in 18:40 UTC. If still green, we'll for complete the swap and update runbooks.

sara_p: Thanks team — great coordination. I'll close the loop once runbooks are updated and I'll add a short blurb to the rollout tracker.
